explanation: One of the patriarchs in the Bible and son of Isaac and Rebekah. He is also known as Israel after God changed his name.
A city in Canaan, where Jacob had a meeting with God. The name means "house of God" in Hebrew.
The new name God gave to Jacob after a struggle with an angel. The name means "he who struggles with God" or "God struggles".
Jacob's beloved wife and mother of Joseph and Benjamin. She died during the birth of Benjamin and was buried near Bethel.
The youngest of Jacob's twelve sons and Rachel's second son. His name means "son of my right hand" or "son of the south".
A city in Canaan where Jacob lived after leaving Bethel. The place is also known as Mamre and Kiriath-Arba.
Jacob's father and son of Abraham and Sarah. He was one of the three patriarchs in the Bible and father to Esau and Jacob.
